name: @estebanforge/pi-antigravity-bridge
description: Gemini provider for Pi on the Antigravity ACP server (official Google ACP) or the stream-json agy CLI. Use antigravity/* models in Pi. Full /model picker support. Models runs Pi's tools. ToS safe to use.
